results.title: Simultaneous orthogonalization by the Gram operator
results.conditions: Arbitrary von Neumann algebra; finite projection family; pairwise product norm at most d; (m-1)d<1.
results.conclusions: Orthogonal equivalent projections with the same join and distance at most 3(m-1)d.
results.entry_assumptions: Complete real and complex scalars, inner-product axioms, finite-dimensional algebra and the definitions of Hilbert spaces and concrete von Neumann algebras.

prerequisites.scope: Foundation A in full; GP0 opening four paragraphs through bounded adjoints and the norm-square identity.
H2 finite direct sums and matrix corners; H3 norm series and Cauchy products; Section1 formal binomial coefficient identities.

results.title: Factorial orthogonalization bound
results.conclusions: The same corrected family has distance strictly below m!d.
results.entry_assumptions: Complete real and complex scalars, inner-product axioms, finite-dimensional algebra and the definitions of Hilbert spaces and concrete von Neumann algebras.

prerequisites.scope: Foundation A in full; GP0 opening four paragraphs through bounded adjoints and the norm-square identity.
H2 finite direct sums and matrix corners; H3 norm series and Cauchy products; Section1 formal binomial coefficient identities.

results.title: Moving hyperfinite tensor factors
results.conditions: M strongly stable with separable predual; A and B hyperfinite II₁ unital tensor factors of M; both tensor complements isomorphic to M.
results.conclusions: An approximately inner automorphism of M maps A onto B.

results.title: Outer period and obstruction are outer-conjugacy invariants
results.conditions: An automorphism of an arbitrary factor with finite positive outer period p.
results.conclusions: Its p-th-power implementer has a choice-independent phase γ with γ^p=1; both p and γ are invariant under outer conjugacy.

results.title: Vanishing obstruction and a cyclic perturbation
results.conditions: An automorphism of an arbitrary factor with finite positive outer period p.
results.conclusions: The obstruction is 1 exactly when an inner perturbation has p-th power equal to the identity; for p>1 this is a faithful properly outer cyclic action.

results.title: Realization of every period and admissible phase
results.conditions: Any integer p≥1 and phase γ with γ^p=1.
results.conclusions: An automorphism of the hyperfinite II₁ factor has outer period p and obstruction γ.

results.title: Equivariant independent normal copies of orbit algebras
results.conditions: A factor M with separable predual, every free ultrafilter, a countable group action on M_ω induced by chosen coordinate automorphisms, and countably generated algebras A and invariant B. The chosen lifts need not form an action on M.
results.conclusions: A normal equivariant trace-preserving copy of B commutes with A and is trace-independent of it; multiplication identifies A⊗̄B normally with the generated image. Invariance of A is needed only for equivariance of that tensor identification.

results.title: Countably many independent equivariant normal copies
results.conditions: The preceding independent-copy hypotheses, with A invariant.
results.conclusions: A normal invariant copy of A tensor countably many copies of B preserves the original inclusion of A, the product trace, and diagonal action. Its image is the generated subalgebra.

results.title: Free Gaussian models and amenable relative projection towers
results.conditions: A factor M with separable predual, every free ultrafilter, a countable group action on M_ω with chosen coordinate lifts and nontrivial action at every nonidentity element; P is a countably generated invariant unital algebra.
results.conclusions: P′∩M_ω contains an invariant abelian Gaussian model with essentially free probability-space action. If the group is amenable, finite disjoint relative projection towers have exact internal covariance, arbitrarily small uncovered trace, and both oriented weighted boundary masses arbitrarily small.

results.title: Exact amenable unitary cohomology with fixed relative coefficients
results.conditions: The preceding Gaussian-model hypotheses and an amenable group; c_g is a left unitary cocycle in D=P′∩M_ω.
results.conclusions: A unitary w in the original D satisfies c_g=wγ_g(w*) for every g; the original cocycle and prescribed relative coefficients retain their output coordinates throughout the diagonal.

results.title: Relative eigenunitaries for all allowed countable-abelian characters
results.conditions: M is a strongly stable factor with separable predual; α is an action of a countable discrete abelian group G; H is its centrally trivial subgroup. Every free ultrafilter ω and every separable-predual von Neumann subalgebra P⊂M_ω are allowed.
results.conclusions: For every χ trivial on H, a unitary U in P′∩M_ω satisfies α_g^ω(U)=χ(g)U for all g. These are exactly the possible unitary eigencharacters. Finite and infinite-cyclic shortcut constructions retain the same relative setting.

results.title: Bounded faithful-normal representation transport
results.conditions: Arbitrary von Neumann algebra and Hilbert space; faithful normal representation; norm-bounded actual net.
results.conclusions: Intrinsic ultrastrong convergence is equivalent to strong convergence in the represented algebra, and bounded ultrastrong topology is preserved.

results.title: Faithful normal semifinite tracial representation
results.conditions: An arbitrary von Neumann algebra with a given faithful normal semifinite trace.
results.conclusions: Its left tracial representation is faithful and normal; bounded square-integrable and finite-trace-corner vectors are dense.

results.title: The exact center of a finite free-action fixed algebra
results.conditions: An intertwiner-free action of a finite group on any nonzero von Neumann algebra; no factor or cardinality restriction.
results.conclusions: The fixed algebra center is precisely the invariant ambient center.

results.title: Finiteness transfer for invariant corners
results.conditions: The same finite free action; a projection in its fixed algebra.
results.conclusions: Finiteness in the fixed algebra implies ambient finiteness; ambient proper infiniteness implies proper infiniteness in the fixed algebra.

results.title: Exact general finite free-action unitary coboundaries
results.conditions: The same finite free action and a left unitary one-cocycle u_st=u_s alpha_s(u_t).
results.conclusions: One unitary v satisfies u_s=v* alpha_s(v) for every group element; the corresponding perturbation is inner conjugate to the original action.

results.title: Finite division without abelian projections
results.conditions: M has no nonzero abelian projection; any Hilbert-space dimension and center; e is a projection and n is a positive integer.
results.conclusions: e is the sum of n orthogonal equivalent projections, all nonzero if e is nonzero, with equivalences inside eMe.

results.title: Full matrix units in the prescribed corner
results.conditions: The finite-division hypotheses with e nonzero.
results.conclusions: The corner eMe contains an injective unital copy of Mn(C), with diagonal sum e.

results.title: Algebraic simplicity of the outer group
results.conditions: R is the separable hyperfinite II1 factor. The stated exact outer-conjugacy classification and tensor-absorption prerequisites are retained; their complete proofs are outside this selection.
results.conclusions: Out(R) has only the trivial and whole normal subgroups, without a closure hypothesis.

results.title: A fixed-coordinate approximate-to-exact cocycle diagonal
results.conditions: M is a separable-predual factor, omega is free, Q is countable, its action on M_omega has specified lifts to Aut(M), and V is a genuine cocycle satisfying every finite approximate equation.
results.conclusions: One unitary Z satisfies V_q=Z gamma_q(Z*) for every q without resampling the fixed cocycle.

results.title: Exact cohomology for locally finite groups
results.conditions: The same quotient setting, Q countable locally finite, and the action free in the intertwiner sense.
results.conclusions: Every genuine unitary cocycle is a coboundary, using the exact finite nonfactor theorem.

results.title: Boundary, coverage and covariance bound
results.conditions: A trace-preserving action on a finite tracial algebra; orthogonal equal-weight levels per shape; own-labelled commutation; genuine cocycle.
results.conclusions: The assembled unitary has cocycle error at most eta_g + 2sqrt(B_g) + 2sqrt(delta).

results.title: A compressed unitary completed inside its finite corner
results.conditions: A finite von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state, any projection e and unitary v; no factor assumption.
results.conclusions: There is u in U(eFe) with ||ve-u||_2 <= ||[v,e]||_2, using the original trace.

results.title: Five-error bound for weighted approximate towers
results.conditions: Orthogonal finite tower levels, trace-preserving group action and genuine unitary cocycle; no equal-weight or exact-commutation assumption.
results.conclusions: A corrected unitary has error at most 2kappa + eta_g + sqrt(BL_g) + sqrt(BR_g) + 2sqrt(delta).

results.title: Approximate cyclic towers in a finite algebra
results.conditions: Finite von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state; trace-preserving aperiodic automorphism; arbitrary predual and center.
results.conclusions: For every n and epsilon, an orthogonal partition of1 is cyclically permuted within epsilon in trace L2.

results.title: Close equivalent projections in a general factor
results.conditions: Separable-predual factor of any type; p_k~q_k and p_k-q_k tends strong-star to0; no centralizing hypothesis.
results.conclusions: Partial isometries have exact initial p_k, final q_k and v_k-q_k tends strong-star to0; corresponding fixed finite partitions admit conjugating unitaries tending to1.

results.title: A finite cyclic model with an exact action
results.conditions: Strongly stable separable-predual factor, approximately inner automorphism of asymptotic period0, prescribed finite predual tests and positive tolerance.
results.conclusions: A small inner perturbation agrees exactly with a cyclic matrix action; the original implementer retains global predual approximation, and its normalized finite-period unitary acts on the matrix factor.

results.title: Absorbing the Bernoulli action of the centrally trivial quotient
results.conditions: Strongly stable separable-predual factor with a countable amenable group action, under the exact stated centralizer, tower and approximation foundations; no outer-action hypothesis.
results.conclusions: A normal onto isomorphism to the Bernoulli tensor product and a genuine unitary cocycle conjugate the actions. The semifinite trace and exact chosen inner-subgroup phases are preserved.

results.title: Ultraweakly closed ideals are generated by central projections
results.conditions: An ultraweakly closed two-sided ideal in an arbitrary von Neumann algebra.
results.conclusions: The ideal is Pz for a central projection z; a unital normal homomorphism from a factor is injective.

results.title: Tensor products of factors are factors
results.conditions: Arbitrary faithful Hilbert-space representations, with P a factor.
results.conclusions: The relative commutant of P tensor 1 in the spatial product is 1 tensor Q; when Q is also a factor, the spatial product is a factor.

results.title: A bijective normal homomorphism has a globally normal inverse
results.conditions: A bijective unital normal star homomorphism between von Neumann algebras.
results.conclusions: The predual map is an onto isometry, and the inverse homomorphism is ultraweakly continuous on the whole algebra.

results.title: Almost invariant inner implementers for every fixed integer power
results.conditions: A factor with separable predual, an approximately inner automorphism, and no nonzero centrally trivial power, under the exact central-tower cohomology and quotient/lifting foundations.
results.conclusions: There is an ordinary sequence of unitary implementers whose inner automorphisms converge in the predual u-topology and whose every fixed integer power is asymptotically invariant in the strong-star topology.

results.title: Exact unitary cohomology for asymptotically aperiodic automorphisms
results.conditions: Factor with separable predual; free ultrafilter; asymptotic period zero; exact stated tower and quotient foundations.
results.conclusions: The prescribed unitary has an exact cohomology solution, with the left-cocycle adjoint convention and fixed-coordinate selection explicit.

results.title: An arbitrarily small inner perturbation conjugate to the original tensor model
results.conditions: Strongly stable factor with separable predual and the stated asymptotic period; full exact matrix and tensor foundations.
results.conclusions: For every model period including zero, the small perturbation is conjugate to the unperturbed action tensored with its model; the perturbed self-absorption theorem is retained.

results.title: Faithful-state tests for bounded strong-star topology
results.conditions: Specified faithful normal state, norm-bounded arbitrary net, arbitrary faithful normal representation.
results.conclusions: The state seminorm tests full bounded strong-star topology, with uniform finite and moving functional tests and jointly indexed ordinary extraction.

results.title: Aperiodic comparison with one small perturbation
results.conditions: Strongly stable factor with separable predual; both automorphisms approximately inner and asymptotically aperiodic; stated exact programme prerequisites.
results.conclusions: Approximately inner conjugacy up to a single arbitrarily small inner perturbation in the originally prescribed faithful normal state.

results.title: Finite-period classification by the implementing phase
results.conditions: Strongly stable factor with separable predual; approximately inner automorphisms with the same positive outer and asymptotic period.
results.conclusions: Equal obstructions are equivalent to outer conjugacy, with full cyclic extraction and the identity tensor leg supplied.

results.title: Positive-functional normality without countability restrictions
results.conditions: Any bounded positive complex-linear functional on any concrete von Neumann algebra; arbitrary directed positive nets.
results.conclusions: Preservation of bounded increasing positive suprema is equivalent to full ultraweak continuity, through complete supplied weight and convexity proofs.

results.title: Exactly fixed finite-order implementers
results.conditions: Strongly stable factor with separable predual; approximately inner theta, theta^p=id and asymptotic period p>=1.
results.conclusions: Theta-fixed unitaries of exact p-th power one whose conjugations converge to theta; uniform spectral-cut root normalization is proved.

results.title: Genuine conjugacy with the original cyclic tensor action
results.conditions: Same full cyclic hypotheses, including the asymptotic-period equality.
results.conclusions: Theta is conjugate to the original theta tensor sigma_p, by original-action absorption, scalar normalization and general finite-action coboundary.

results.title: One fixed Weyl shift for an entire implementing sequence
results.conditions: Strongly stable separable-predual factor; approximately inner period-p action with asymptotic period p>=2; prescribed finite-order eigenunitary, faithful state and positive tolerance.
results.conclusions: A single nearby eigenunitary forms exact Weyl pairs with an entire fixed finite-order implementing sequence; p=1 is separately stated.

results.title: Discrete trace-scaling coboundaries via suspension
results.conditions: Specified trace-scaling automorphism of a separable-predual semifinite algebra, with nonunit multiplier; stated real stability and measurable-field foundations.
results.conclusions: Every specified unitary is a coboundary; the suspension checks action, measure, continuity and one-time fiber selection.

results.title: Centrally trivial automorphisms are inner times modular
results.conditions: Hyperfinite type III_lambda factor with separable predual, 0<lambda<1; stated decomposition and centralizer foundations.
results.conclusions: Full inner-times-modular description with unique outer time modulo the modular period.

results.title: Product normal-functional density
results.conditions: Exact hypotheses in TF1
results.conclusions: The interface theorem holds under the prerequisites stated in the companion.

results.title: Specified tracial product maps extend normally
results.conditions: Exact hypotheses in TF3
results.conclusions: The interface theorem holds under the prerequisites stated in the companion.

results.title: Type-I amplification preserves the full asymptotic centralizer
results.conditions: Arbitrary von Neumann algebra with separable predual; any free ultrafilter; no factor or trace assumption.
results.conclusions: The prescribed identity-leg embedding is a normal equivariant isomorphism with normal inverse and preserves central triviality and asymptotic period.

results.title: A nonunit trace multiplier determines conjugacy
results.conditions: Hyperfinite semifinite factor, separable predual, equal nonunit multipliers; stated full tensor, finite-factor and DS foundations.
results.conclusions: Conjugacy with the exact specified cocycle orientation; multiplier-one counterexample retained.

results.title: Every specified trace-scaling integer cocycle is a coboundary
results.conditions: Semifinite algebra with separable predual and faithful normal semifinite trace; nonunit multiplier; exact W1–W3/T1 imports.
results.conclusions: Specified-unitary cocycle solution for all integer values, with the stated inner-conjugacy orientation, including nonfactors.

results.title: Central triviality and core normalizers in type III-zero
results.conditions: Approximately finite-dimensional type III-zero factor with separable predual and the stated standard-form, discrete-normalization, measurable-field, selection, semifinite and strong-stability foundations.
results.conclusions: Full centrally trivial/core-normalizer equality, every faithful-state cocycle form and integer-period branch.

results.title: Dual fixed points, relative commutants and specified central cocycles
results.conditions: General von Neumann algebra and specified strongly continuous central cocycle, with explicit F1–F4 foundations.
results.conclusions: Specified unitary realization and exact left-unitary ambiguity; full normalizer description in every faithful-state chart.

results.title: Faithful normal semifinite scalar traces
results.conditions: An arbitrary von Neumann algebra in which each nonzero projection majorizes a nonzero finite projection.
results.conclusions: A faithful normal semifinite scalar trace, with increasing finite-value approximants; converse and equivalent central-projection formulation.

results.title: The finite center-valued trace
results.conditions: An arbitrary finite von Neumann algebra.
results.conclusions: Unique normal normalized faithful center-valued trace, full ultraweak continuity, comparison and naturality.

results.title: Simultaneous norm averaging
results.conditions: Any von Neumann algebra and any finite family of complex elements; finiteness only for identification with the center-valued trace.
results.conclusions: One sequence of finite unitary averages converges in norm to central elements; in the finite case the central hull is the center-valued trace singleton.

results.title: Extension of an arbitrary normal corner trace
results.conditions: Any projection and any normal trace on its corner, including nonfaithful and infinite-valued traces.
results.conclusions: Unique normal extension supported on the central support, with equivalence of faithfulness and semifiniteness.

results.title: The Powers model
results.conditions: 0<lambda<1; the modular foundations stated in PC8, whose theorem proves the full factorial-centralizer spectral identity.
results.conclusions: AFD type III-lambda factor with explicit modular spectrum, finite factorial centralizer, diagonal expectation and flip-action presentation.

results.title: Crossed-product recognition with prescribed generators
results.conditions: Countable group; faithful normal state on Q; faithful normal expectation with vanishing nonidentity coefficients; exact generating group representation.
results.conclusions: Normal isomorphism carrying each specified coefficient and unitary to the regular representation.

results.title: Uniqueness of semifinite factor traces
results.conditions: A semifinite factor and two faithful normal semifinite traces.
results.conclusions: One strictly positive finite scalar relates the traces on the entire positive cone.

results.title: Injective type III-lambda uniqueness
results.conditions: Separable predual, 0<lambda<1, injectivity, the explicit PC0 imports and the modular foundations of PC8.
results.conclusions: Normal isomorphism to the Powers model with the same parameter; AFD corollary.

results.title: Full fixed-corner spectrum for a factorial fixed algebra
results.conditions: Normal real action continuous on normal scalar coefficients, on a nonzero von Neumann algebra; fixed algebra is a factor.
results.conclusions: Every nonzero fixed corner has the full action spectrum, hence that spectrum equals the Connes spectrum. No cardinality, state or periodicity restriction.

results.title: Full factorial-centralizer spectral identity
results.conditions: Nonzero factor; faithful normal semifinite weight with factorial centralizer; exact earlier MG-0–MG-3 and CS-3 foundations.
results.conclusions: The S-invariant, intersected over all faithful normal semifinite weights, equals the entire modular spectrum, including zero. No state, separability or periodicity restriction.

results.title: Norm-one projections onto unital C*-subalgebras
results.conditions: Nonzero unital C*-algebras B contained in A with the same unit, and a linear retraction E:A→B of norm one.
results.conclusions: E is unital, completely positive and B-bimodular, with E(x)*E(x)≤E(x*x). No normality or cardinality restriction.

results.title: Representation-independent injectivity criterion
results.conditions: A nonzero von Neumann algebra in any faithful normal unital representation.
results.conclusions: Completely positive extension preserving the unit value is equivalent to a ucp retraction and to a norm-one projection from the ambient bounded operators.

results.title: Invariant-state finite classification
results.conditions: A type II1 factor in its faithful trace representation, with a state on the ambient bounded operators invariant under its inner conjugations. The state need not be normal.
results.conclusions: Injectivity and local AFD without a separability assumption; with separable predual, a generating increasing dyadic matrix sequence and a normal isomorphism with R.

results.title: Tracial quotients, normal embeddings and expectations
results.conditions: A nonzero von Neumann algebra with a faithful normal tracial state and a free ultrafilter on the positive integers. No factoriality or separability hypothesis. Expectations allow every unital von Neumann subalgebra of a faithfully tracial finite algebra.
results.conclusions: A finite von Neumann ultrapower with faithful normal trace, a faithful normal constant embedding and normal inverse onto its range, unitary coordinate representatives, faithful normal trace-preserving ucp expectations and center-valued projection comparison in relative commutants.

results.title: Normal tensor homomorphisms and completely positive maps
results.conditions: Concrete von Neumann algebras in arbitrary faithful normal representations; normal star homomorphisms or bounded normal completely positive maps, including nonunital and zero maps. No trace or separability assumption.
results.conclusions: Unique normal tensor maps, exact kernel and range for homomorphisms, faithful-representation independence, full normal minimal dilation for cp maps, tensor norm equality, and predual continuity and approximate innerness of tensor automorphisms.

results.title: Powers subfactors from periodic states
results.conditions: A factor with separable predual of type III-lambda,0<lambda<1, and a specified faithful normal state with modular period2pi/abs(loglambda). No ambient injectivity or AFD assumption.
results.conclusions: A unital normal copy of the Powers factor preserving the product state and intertwining every modular time; seven solved exercises include arbitrary residue blocks.

results.title: Making towers commute with a fixed cocycle
results.conditions: A separable-predual factor, any free ultrafilter, an arbitrary induced countable-group action and countably many fixed coefficients.
results.conclusions: Finite-partition reindexing preserves every trace and specified covariance norm for arbitrary induced countable-group actions. Weighted errors and the fixed-cocycle diagonal give a conditional cohomology criterion. The Gaussian projection theorem supplies that criterion for faithful induced countable amenable actions;

results.title: Free actions after fixing coefficients
results.conditions: A separable-predual factor and induced countable-group action; countably generated invariant coefficient algebra. Each group element used for freeness acts nontrivially on the full asymptotic centralizer. Finite cocycle correction uses a free finite-group action and faithful invariant trace.
results.conclusions: Relative coefficient-intertwiner freeness for every nontrivial induced countable-group element; finite-group unitary cocycle correction in an arbitrary finite coefficient commutant with its faithful invariant trace. The central trace comparison and crossed-product proofs are included.

results.title: Inner approximations compatible with characteristic data
results.conditions: Countable amenable group acting on the separable hyperfinite type II-infinity factor; a trace-preserving comparison automorphism with a genuine cocycle and exact compatibility on every inner-subgroup implementer. No outer-action or trace-preserving-generator assumption.
results.conclusions: Compatible inner pairs converge simultaneously in the automorphism u-topology and pointwise strong-star cocycle topology. All cyclic periods, including zero, are included. The conditional arbitrary-factor theorem and abelian scalar-character correction are proved separately.

results.title: Gluing comparisons of isotropy actions
results.conditions: Countable Borel groupoid with supplied finite principal exhaustion, Borel roots and enumerations; amenable isotropy actions on a fixed separable hyperfinite semifinite factor; actual Borel isotropy comparison cocycles, arrowwise trace alignment and compatible multiplication/transport phases of chosen inner implementers.
results.conclusions: A Borel comparison and genuine unitary cocycle on the whole groupoid, preserving the prescribed trace gauge and the chosen inner implementers.

results.conclusions: Characteristic model with actual phases at the stated full scope and actual phase conventions.

results.conclusions: Represented Borel characteristic model at the stated full scope and actual phase conventions.

results.conclusions: Simultaneous phase and trace normalization at the stated full scope and actual phase conventions.

results.conclusions: Groupoid comparison from compatible actual data at the stated full scope and actual phase conventions.

results.conditions: Exact scalar correction on a supplied increasing finite Borel relation, including descent from matched inner isotropy. General initial comparison and outer isotropy have separate scope;
results.conclusions: Compatible scalar correction on a finite exhaustion under the stated exact coefficient and action hypotheses.

results.conditions: Unitary correction on principal relations and the asymptotic centralizer, with pointwise approximate comparison on the original factor. Exact original-factor cocycles are supplied by the subsequent near-identity lesson.
results.conclusions: Exact centralizer two-cocycle correction under the stated exact coefficient and action hypotheses.

results.title: Full-group detection by asymptotically invariant functions
results.conditions: Aperiodic nonsingular transformation of a standard probability space; arbitrary nonsingular comparison transformation.
results.conclusions: Full-group membership is equivalent to fixing every uniformly bounded asymptotically invariant sequence. Nonmembership has a selfadjoint unitary witness with fixed positive displacement.

results.title: Inner implementation of the centre correction
results.conditions: The nonsingular aperiodic discrete decomposition (2.1) and a centrally trivial automorphism preserving its coefficient algebra.
results.conclusions: An explicit unitary normalizes the coefficient algebra and removes the centre action by inner perturbation.

results.title: Cocycle removal for a varying central return roof
results.conditions: The full semifinite coefficient system (2.1), with positive central density bounded above by q<1 and separable predual. The density need not be constant.
results.conclusions: Every specified unitary c equals z*theta(z) for one unitary z in the original coefficient algebra, with the resulting coboundary identity for every integer.

results.title: Inner normalization of the crossed-product implementer
results.conditions: An automorphism preserves N in (2.1) and fixes its centre pointwise.
results.conclusions: An inner perturbation by a unitary in N fixes U and commutes with theta on N, while still preserving N and fixing its centre.

results.title: Full normal comparison of two lacunary centralizer corners
results.conditions: Separable predual, faithful normal semifinite lacunary weight of infinite multiplicity, and an arbitrary automorphism alpha.
results.conclusions: There are nonzero central cuts c,e of the original centralizer and a partial isometry w from c to alpha(e), giving mutually inverse normal isomorphisms of the whole coefficient corners. Equality c=e is not asserted.

results.title: Lacunary weight transport from a matched centralizer cut
results.conditions: The setting of Proposition2.E, with M a type III factor, and the additional full matched-corner isomorphism (2.F1).
results.conclusions: The explicit unitary v*u alpha(v) gives an inner perturbation preserving the centralizer of the transported faithful normal semifinite lacunary weight of infinite multiplicity.

results.title: Partial orbit maps detected by asymptotically invariant unitary functions
results.conditions: Aperiodic nonsingular T on a standard probability space and a nonsingular partial isomorphism S:D to E. Every uniformly bounded sign-valued sequence asymptotically fixed by T is asymptotically fixed under S on E.
results.conclusions: S takes almost every point of D into its T-orbit, without an invariant measure or bounded Radon–Nikodym derivative assumption.

results.title: Lacunary normalization from central triviality and a partial orbit implementer
results.conditions: The full type III-zero system (2.1), its faithful NSF lacunary weight of infinite multiplicity, and alpha centrally trivial.
results.conclusions: There is a nonzero central cut c with a full normal matched-corner map from alpha(Nc) onto Nc. An inner perturbation therefore preserves a suitable lacunary centralizer, and further inner perturbations fix its center and integer implementer.

results.title: Global central phase sequences from a variable automorphism field
results.conditions: Standard probability base with ergodic nonsingular T; Borel fields of automorphisms of a separable strongly stable factor, intertwined by return transports. The non-centrally-trivial locus has positive measure.
results.conclusions: One fixed nontrivial phase and a measurable unitary sequence central in the whole coefficient algebra, with ordinary strong-star phase convergence.

results.title: Centrally trivial normalized automorphisms have centrally trivial fibres
results.conditions: The full nonsingular type III-zero system2.1 and a centrally trivial automorphism preserving N and fixing C and U.
results.conclusions: Almost every coefficient-fibre automorphism is centrally trivial, with no constancy of the field or invariant probability assumption.

results.title: A measurable unitary implements the whole coefficient action
results.conditions: Proposition6.3, the semifinite Ct=Inn theorem and completed-measure selection for a Borel relation in the Polish unitary group.
results.conclusions: A unitary v in N implements the center-fixing action on every bounded measurable coefficient field.

results.title: Periodic central cocycles and their transfer unitaries
results.conditions: Strongly continuous unitary cocycles for negative translation on a circle of length L; P=2pi/L.
results.conclusions: The circuit value identifies cohomology with R/PZ; Fubini and Fourier constructions give a transfer unitary, unique up to a scalar.

results.title: The periodic characteristic square
results.conditions: Hyperfinite type III-lambda factor with separable predual; stated core, modular and centrally trivial converse inputs.
results.conclusions: Six short exact sequences, all four commuting cells and their automorphism/dual-flow equivariance.

results.title: Cyclic characteristic coordinates
results.conditions: Normalized automorphism and stated modular return data; positive and zero asymptotic periods distinguished.
results.conclusions: The cyclic pair determines the corrected finite obstruction and modular return, with the module retained as coefficient action.

results.title: A modular action on one tensor factor
results.conditions: Faithful normal state on the Powers factor, irrational modular-time ratio; classification conclusion additionally assumes modular cyclic-return completeness.
results.conclusions: Ordinary central tail witnesses give asymptotic period zero; the core coordinate gives trivial module; the stated comparison gives outer conjugacy.

results.title: One-factor action comparison
results.conditions: The stated hyperfinite semifinite comparison foundations; countable amenable group and genuine actions.
results.conclusions: Equal inner kernels, full characteristic classes and trace multipliers give a normal comparison and genuine unitary cocycle.

results.title: Characters of a cyclic return quotient
results.conditions: p>0, 0<=q<p, s=qL/p; L>0 and P=2pi/L.
results.conclusions: The relation gamma^p c^(-q)=1 is parametrized by a fixed half-open return representative and a p-th root delta.

results.title: Normal crossed-product cocycle lift
results.conditions: A genuine two-generator unitary cocycle and the specified normal semifinite comparison.
results.conclusions: Spatial conjugation gives the normal isomorphism, its inverse and the outer-conjugacy equation.

results.title: Modular-return outer conjugacy
results.conditions: All normalization, central-triviality, finite-model and comparison hypotheses stated in the lesson.
results.conclusions: Positive asymptotic period is classified by p, corrected obstruction, return time and module; zero period by module alone.
